summary: Tested the Provider Ledger feature end to end against live shared Supabase, using 2 TEST_probe hospitals (phones 9999900021/22). Each probe had one TEST emergency_cases row for patient 9afe9c0c. Backend: 46/46 pytest checks passed (test_provider_ledger.py). They cover access control, the providers list and detail, file upload and streaming with type/size/ownership rules, Gemini AI extraction of sample_bill.pdf, service validation (proof, patient, date, category, foreign proof), the provider submit → review approve/reject flow, promotions, billing terms, settings, and invoices. Invoice checks: CGST/SGST vs IGST math, SAC and month rules, duplicate block, item locks, PDF, share (Supabase notification row checked), provider visibility, paid, void and unlock, re-invoice. Frontend tested with Playwright: admin list (KPIs, search, type filter, toggle, month), Xenon detail (2 patient cards, service details expand, 4 tabs), AI autofill dialog (title, amount 70000, surgery, 3 line items, proof chip), the no-proof error toast, save → approved, promotions add/delete, billing save that persists, raise invoice that computes correctly, PDF download, share, paid, the provider console (/provider/ledger shows only the paid invoice; provider submit → pending review), review queue (reject needs a reason, approve with an adjusted amount), and the settings page save that persists. The PDF template renders cleanly. Found a HIGH race condition: concurrent invoice creation double-bills.

critical.issue: Race condition: 4 concurrent POSTs for the same provider and month gave 3x 200, creating TH/202605/0001-0003. All 3 included the same promotion line, so the provider was billed 3 times. The duplicate-month check (find_one) and the item locking (update_many after insert) are not atomic. Fix: add a unique partial index on ledger_invoices {provider_user_id, month} where status != 'void', or claim the items atomically first (update_many invoice_id: None → reserve id, then build lines from what was claimed).

App services are billed whatever their status. Xenon's consultations with status PENDING_HOSPITAL (not delivered yet) were invoiced at 10%. Cancelled, rejected or no-show bookings would also be billed. Filter auto services to completed/delivered statuses, or let the admin exclude lines.

minor.issue: There is no status check, so an already rejected (or approved) entry can be re-reviewed. Re-approving a rejected item returned 200 approved. Limit this to pending_review, or record an explicit override audit.
If parse_ai_json returns a non-dict (list or str), parsed.get raises an unhandled 500. Guard with isinstance(parsed, dict).
The state comparison is free text ('MH' vs 'Maharashtra' → wrongly IGST). Use a state dropdown or GST state code (first 2 digits of the GSTIN).
The patient falls back only to patient_name, so the PDF shows '—' when the Supabase user has no name. Auto lines fall back to the phone; do the same for manual lines and the review card.
Does not check is_deleted, so deleting twice returns success.
There is no 'Place of supply' line, which a GST tax invoice requires. Consider adding the provider state code there.

ui_bugs.issue: Notes show 'Dr. Dr. R. Mehta' because the 'Dr.' prefix is added even when doctor_name already has it.
The row has hover styling, but clicking anywhere except the provider name does nothing. Only ledger-open-{uid} navigates. Make the whole row clickable.
The SAC field is empty when the tab first renders. The default_sac arrives later from the /ledger/settings fetch and silently fills the field, even after the user has cleared it.

integration_issues.issue: Xenon shows 2 patient cards that are the same person (Siddharth Gupta, 9873117605) under 2 different patient_ids. Patients are keyed only by patient_id. Consider merging by phone.

issues: These use the browser's native date and month pickers instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover
State is a free-text input, but it decides CGST+SGST vs IGST. Use a select of Indian states.
'first visit' mixes relative ('5d ago') and absolute ('8/21/2026') formats

action_items: HIGH: Make invoice creation atomic: unique partial index on (provider_user_id, month, status!=void), or atomic claiming of items. This prevents duplicate invoices and double-billed lines under concurrent requests.
HIGH: Bill only delivered/completed Patient-App services. Exclude PENDING, CANCELLED and REJECTED bookings from invoice lines and from month_billable.
Guard ai_extract against non-dict AI output
Add a patient phone fallback for manual invoice lines and review cards
Fix the duplicated 'Dr.' prefix in AI notes
Use a state dropdown or GSTIN state code for the GST same-state decision; add Place of Supply to the PDF
Optional: whole-row click in the ledger table; shadcn date pickers; patient dedupe by phone
critical_code_review_comments: ledger.py is 782 lines (>700). Move render_invoice_html and _inr_words into ledger_invoice_pdf.py.
create_invoice does find_one duplicate check → insert → update_many lock with no atomicity (confirmed double billing)
fee_for uses the auto-service 'kind' (sos, admission, consultation, …) as the category key. That works, but category_fee_pct allows overlapping keys ('consultation' is in both lists).
Orphan proof files (uploaded, never attached) stay in object storage and ledger_files forever, with no cleanup
Voiding a paid/shared invoice is allowed without a credit-note trail. Consider GST credit notes for shared invoices.

success_rate.backend: 100% of 46 planned tests passed; 2 HIGH issues found in additional probing

Also delete the ledger_counters inv-2025-12 doc and restore settings. test_restore_settings restores the Trata settings. For UI, inject trata_token plus trata_user (security_setup_required=false) into localStorage. To retest the race fix, fire 4 parallel POST /invoices for the same month and expect exactly 1 x 200.
rca of the issue: Double invoicing: create_invoice reads existing invoices (find_one), builds lines from items with invoice_id None, inserts the invoice, and only then sets invoice_id on the items. Concurrent requests all pass the check and all see the same unlocked items. Reproduce: add a promo for a provider, then send 4 threaded POST /api/ledger/providers/{uid}/invoices {month, sac_code}. This gave 3 issued invoices for the same month, each with the promo line. Mitigation: unique partial index plus catching DuplicateKeyError → 400, or atomic per-item claim with find_one_and_update.
